flags.observation: "one card per line" describes process, not premise; the sentence is portable to any Kayfabe deck song and has no stand-up punch.
"his Squash Match instantly destroys his Jobbers" recites the power effect as a rule and fuses lore and power into a new claim.
Third opener ending on "him" ("No genie for him", "The Roc drops him", "Nobody bribes him"); opener cadence starts to repeat.
Outro punch is concrete and calls back the intro axe and streaming bosses, but carries no insider dog whistle for experts.
Style A asks for a female talk-sung lead while beat 2 casts Uncle FrizzleBob as the male ring announcer; voice and persona clash.
